IncidentBot: PAGER -> P1: auth-service 503 spike (region: us-west1). Customers experiencing failures on token exchange. PagerDuty incident: PD12345. Please acknowledge if you are taking driver/comms.

Raj K: acknowledged. I'm coming up as primary driver for the next 30m. starting handoff now.

Maria G: I'll take comms. Notifying CSM + support channel. Posting initial customer impact note. :loudspeaker: 

Alex P: I'm secondary for this window — can jump in for infra escalations if needed.

Raj K: quick status — error rate up ~14% over baseline, 503s originate from /v1/auth/token. Rolling error increase at 15:04 PDT. Traces show spike in auth-db latency.

Taylor L: pinging infra to check DB replicas, but leaving primary ownership to Raj for triage steps.

Raj K: short runbook snippet I'm following:
```
1) check service logs: kubectl -n prod logs deploy/auth-service --since=10m
2) query db latency: SELECT pg_controldata();
3) if replica lag > 5s -> failover candidate: db-replica-2
4) if can't mitigate in 15m -> scale auth-service to 6 replicas and enable fallback-token path
```

Maria G: posting to #support: "auth-service 503 spike affecting token exchange. Engineering investigating; ETA 30m. We'll update every 10m or on significant changes." Added CSM @sarah.

Sam V: FYI, there is a maintenance window in eu-west1 later, not related. No scheduled jobs right now.

Raj K: quick checklist for handoff tie-off before I leave in 25m:
- confirm comms owner acknowledged (Maria = yes)
- confirm secondary named (Alex = yes)
- confirm pager escalation policy updated (I bumped PD to priority)
- paste quick mitigation steps into incident doc (done)

Maria G: noted. I'll maintain the incident doc and customer updates. If driver changes, I'll call out @channel and update the PD assignment.

Alex P: if I need to pick up, call out "driver: Alex P" in thread. Also I'll verify circuit-breaker config in config-store.

Taylor L: infra checked replica health: replica-2 lagging ~7s, replica-3 healthy. Recommending promoting replica-3 if failover needed.

Raj K: I'm going to attempt a rolling restart of auth-service on node pool A (low-risk) — will monitor error rate. If no improvement in 8 minutes, escalate to DB failover.

IncidentBot: ACTION -> Raj K started run: rolling-restart auth-service (run_id: r-2026-03-15-001).

Maria G: customer note updated: "Investigating token exchange errors; we've initiated mitigation steps. Next update in 10 minutes or sooner."

Raj K: restart kicked off. watching metrics. if errors go down to <3% over baseline will hold. leaving a short handoff doc in the incident ticket before my shift end.

Alex P: ack. standing by to take driver if you need to step off. Also will check config: `circuit_breakers.auth.max_failures` in vault.

Raj K: thanks team. Tagging post-handoff items for secondary: verify PD escalation policies, ensure rollback play is ready, and confirm comms cadence. I'll hand off driver to Alex if I need to step out.

Maria G: got it. I'll keep the update cadence and escalate to CSM if customers start opening high-priority tickets.

Raj K: (leaving bridge in 10) current plan: continue watch for 10m, if stable transfer driver to Alex, otherwise continue until mitigated.

Alex P: ready to take driver at 17:20 PDT if needed.
